items.note: ἀγαπητῇ (agapētē) 'beloved' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἀδελφῇ (adelphē) 'our sister' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ὑμῖν (humin) 'you' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR) instead of ἡμῖν (hēmin) 'us' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+Byz)
Ἰησοῦν. (Iēsoun) 'Jesus.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
Χάριν (Charin) 'grace' occurs in a few manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of χαρὰν (charan) 'Joy' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg+KJV)
ἔχομεν (echomen) 'we have' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of ἔσχον (eschon) 'I have' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
μου, (mou) 'of mine' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
σὺ (su) 'you yourself' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of σοι (soi) 'to you' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
προσλαβοῦ. (proslabou) 'do yourself receive.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz)
κυρίῳ (kuriō) 'Lord' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Χριστῷ.¶ (Christō) 'Christ.' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
Ἀσπάζονταί (Aspazontai) 'They greet' occurs in traditional manuscripts (TR+Byz) instead of Ἀσπάζεταί (Aspazetai) 'He greets' in older manuscripts (NA28+NA27+Tyn+SBL+WH+Treg)
ἡμῶν (hēmōn) 'of us' is only in traditional manuscripts (Tyn+Treg+TR+Byz)

ἀμήν. Πρός Φιλήμονα ἐγράφη ἀπό Ῥώμης διά Ὀνησίμου οἰκέτου.¶ (amēn Pros Philēmona egraphē apo Rhōmēs dia Onēsimou oiketou) 'Amen. to To Philemon it was written from Rome through Onesimus servant.' is only in traditional manuscripts (TR)
